title: Twilio Segment - Customer Data Platform | Twilio Segment
metaDescription: Twilio Segment is a customer data platform (CDP) that helps you collect, clean, and activate your customer data.
h1: The leading customer data platform, powered by AI
h2: A CDP that works hard for every team, backed by enterprise-grade infrastructure
Provide 1:1 interactions at scale with AI
Activate warehouse data with a CDP that’s powerful yet flexible
The world’s leading brands are powered by Twilio Segment
h3: Keep your data where it is
Enhance every experience with warehouse data
